_comment: Cancellation pattern — NOT a Journey entry event. When a reservation is cancelled, the booking system (1) sends the Day 1 cancellation transactional email, and (2) fires this small API event into the one-step QuickStay_Cancellation_Signal journey, whose only activity is an Update Contact step writing ReservationStatus = Cancelled onto the guest's QS_Reservation_Status record in Contact Data. QuickStay_PreArrival_v1 checks Contact Data before its send and exits a contact whose reservation is Cancelled — see 'How cancellation stops a journey' in journey-design.md. Same fictional cancelled reservation shape as Day 1's cancellation send example; timestamps match it (cancelled 2026-11-20T15:42:00Z, CancellationReference CANC-55190).

_expectedResponse._note: 201 means the signal event was accepted. The pre-arrival exit happens when the contact next reaches the pre-send decision split — which is why that split sits immediately before the email activity, not at Journey entry.
